text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Nooooo! Tell me this isn't true! The<n>shop is gone?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I spot a distraught Pearl standing in<n>front of a bento shop.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer... Pinch me. I must be<n>dreaming—how could this bento shop<n>close?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Your flavors have been passed down<n>and enjoyed by generations! Losing<n>a bento shop is the same as losing<n>part of Japan, so please don't say<n>you're quitting!

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Pearl... I'd like to keep<n>going if I could, but business has<n>been slow.

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: All we get are regulars, which means<n>most of the bentos go to waste every<n>day. It's been tough... so I had to<n>make this decision.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The shop owner droops his shoulders<n>in disappointment. His frustration is<n>as clear as day.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...It's too early for you to give up. The<n>fact that you only get a few<n>customers means that there's plenty<n>of people who haven't tasted your<n>food yet, am I wrong?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We need to spread the word! The<n>world needs to know about these<n>brilliant bentos!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Leave it all to me! I promise I'll save<n>your shop!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let me introduce you to someone.<n>He's an acquaintance of my father<n>and a sales advisor. When I told him<n>about your bento shop, he agreed to<n>help.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: First things first, we'll need to draft<n>up a long-term business plan. I know,<n>we'll aim to open stores across the<n>nation!

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: I-is that really possible?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If you want to increase sales, then<n>everyone knows you have to expand<n>your target market! Simple is best!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And once word starts spreading<n>about your bentos, you'll become a<n>national brand! Even international<n>expansion might not be just a pipe<n>dream!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now, the world is hungry for your<n>bentos! Let's move to the next phase<n>of the plan!

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Hrm... It's usually a ghost town<n>around these parts, so I doubt I'll be<n>eyeing international expansion<n>anytime soon...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hi, Pearl! What's wrong, something<n>got you down? Could it be... you're<n>so hungry you can't move a muscle?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Exactly! How did you know?! How<n>am I supposed to go work out like<n>this!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ha-ha-ha! Well then, this is your lucky<n>day! I've got a deluxe bento with<n>balanced nutrients that'll power up<n>your next workout!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pearl has decided to film a<n>commercial for the bento shop.<n>According to her, this kind of program<n>is all the rage overseas.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now we just need to do some editing<n>and slap some multilingual subtitles<n>on it. Then we upload it for the world<n>to see! Don't underestimate the<n>power of social media!

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: You want to upload it? ...Uh, you think<n>it'll be okay? I've heard social media<n>can be scary... and I really don't want<n>any backlash...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: All we're doing is advertising your<n>bentos—no one could hate on you for<n>that! More importantly, think about all<n>the orders that will soon come in! ♪

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: I can't even sell all my bentos each<n>day as-is... Doubt I'll get any fans<n>from a quick video...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The bento shop owner looks even<n>more dispirited than earlier. It must be<n>hard for him to follow Pearl's gung ho<n>approach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them probably have<n>different visions for the future of the<n>shop. But deep down, I'm sure the<n>owner also wants to see his shop<n>make a comeback.
choice_data_list: I need to do my part to help!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During one of Pearl's recording<n>breaks, I ask her again about what<n>bentos mean to her.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: How should I put it... love? No, that's<n>not quite it. The best way to describe<n>these bentos... is that they taste like<n>home.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Just one bite is enough to fully<n>immerse my taste buds. I see places<n>I've never been to—ancient Japanese<n>landscapes. Haha, it's a<n>one-of-a-kind experience.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The owner's kindness is reflected<n>through the bentos he makes. The<n>taste of home is sweet enough to<n>wash away all the stress of everyday<n>life.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Please, try one for yourself. I<n>recommend the chikuzenni! The<n>bamboo shoots are firm and chewy,<n>but they're packed with flavor—a true<n>work of art!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: His bentos are like jewelry boxes<n>filled with masterpiece after<n>masterpiece! His works have the<n>power to move the world... I'm sure<n>of it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pearl's answer to my question is<n>more passionate than I had expected.<n>I can see her love for bentos through<n>her dedication to helping the owner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If Pearl is this confident, then I'm<n>sure the bentos are world-class<n>quality. However, the owner himself<n>still looks down in the dumps...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We need to give him the courage to<n>take another step—the first step<n>towards a brighter future.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. What's over here? I'm<n>quite busy with my "Worldwide Bento<n>Project," you know.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? A food truck? For the students<n>at Tracen? ...Wait, isn't that the<n>shop's name?!

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Pearl and her trainer! You can<n>see for yourself, but the shop's<n>booming!

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: I never would have thought of<n>opening a food truck! This is near<n>Tracen Academy, so plenty of<n>students pass by every day!
choice_data_list: It's proof that your bentos were always great.

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Hrm... I was so busy feeling sorry for<n>myself I lost sight of what was most<n>important. You know, the customers<n>buying my bentos.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Owner... I didn't know you were that<n>heartbroken...

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: But now, I can look my customers<n>proudly in the eye again. It's like you<n>said Pearl, expansion isn't just a<n>dream!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...! Haha, I'm glad to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Bento Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Well then, back to business!<n>International expansion, here I come!<n>...Kidding, kidding!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's a wonderful dream. I wish you<n>the best of luck! And I'll do my best<n>to help, too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You hear that, everyone? It's first<n>come, first served! Are you really<n>going to pass up a soon-to-be<n>internationally-acclaimed bento?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: One bite and you're hooked!<n>Mmmmm! Amaaazing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Pearl's marketing, all the<n>bentos sell out for the day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grumble...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm getting hungry as well! ...Oh no, I<n>was so wrapped up in selling bentos<n>that I forgot to leave some for us!
choice_data_list:
Don't worry, I thought this would happen so I
bought two!

bought two!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You know me too well, Trainer! Come<n>on, let's go sit on that bench and eat!<n>Haha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sit down next to Pearl and take a<n>bite of the bento. In an instant, my<n>heart is filled with relaxing memories<n>of home...
